trending.title: Introducing Sahara: A Business OS Built on WhatsApp
trending.description: My mother runs a small store in Nepal. My uncle runs a small hotel a few hours away. Neither of them has ever opened an app for their business, not once, and they never will. Everything happens over WhatsApp, the one thing they already know how to use. So that's what I built Sahara on top of: three AWS databases doing real work behind a single phone number, with nothing new for either of them to learn.

trending.title: [59 Days to Go] Build Tagalog Learning App for AWS Manila Community Day with Educational-First Dev Tips
trending.description: Turn the Tagalog learning app into a static HTML demo that can be shared with AWS community builders. The technical focus is practical: keep the app static, keep the content structured, make mobile reading comfortable, and use demo phrases as visible proof that the app supports real event communication. The version a learner can actually use before and during AWS Manila Community Day. Static files, structured prompts, mobile-first layout, and culturally careful sentence cards to create a meaningful demo.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: [60 Days to Go] Build a Tagalog Learning App for AWS Manila Community Day with Prompt-First Product Design
trending.description: Explains how to create a Tagalog learning app for AWS Manila Community Day by treating every prompt as a product decision. The goal is not only translation. The app should help a beginner greet people politely, ask questions, thank volunteers, manage waiting time, and feel ready to connect with the Manila cloud community.

trending.title: 【倒數61天】在前往 Manila Community Day 之前，用 Kiro Build 一個 Tagalog 語言學習 App [Part 2]
trending.description: 一款塔加洛語應用程式成為了連接科技、語言、文化和社區的橋樑。在參加馬尼拉社區日之前，我計劃用兩個月的時間在 Kiro 平台上開發一款塔加洛語學習應用程式。該應用程式融合了生成式人工智慧、入門語言練習、菲律賓語禮貌用語、發音、語法以及適用於各種場合的常用短語。它將英語翻譯成道地的塔加洛語，加入敬語“po”，並幫助學習者與馬尼拉的雲端社群建立聯繫。這款應用程式讓我意識到，語言是一種關係。
